main_text.p: fidei præci-pua attribu-ta.Hæc ut confirmentur, fideiq; officia & necessitas illustretur, indicem præcipuorum fidei attributorum nunc subiungam. Fide intelligimus Deum esse uniuersorum[?] conditorem: Hebr.11.3. In fide sumus, & Iesum Christum in nobis esse statuimus: 2.Cor.13.5. Fide viuimus in Christo: Gal.2.20. Fide uidemus Christum: Ioan.8.56. Fide edimus & bibimus Christum: Ioan.6.35. Fide incedimus: 2.Cor.5.10. Per fidem corda nostra a Deo purificatur: Act.15.9. Fide, ex fide, & per fidem iustificantur electi: Rom.3.28.30. In fide stamus: 1.Cor.16.13. Fide patrissamus[?]: Rom.4.16. Fide benedictionem consequimur cum fideli Abraham: Gal.3.9. Per fidem promissum illum Spiritum accipimus: eode cap.v.14. Fides per charitatem agit: Galat.5.6. Ideo celebratur ἔργου τῆς πίστεως[?], 1. Thess.1.3. Per fidem habitat Christus in cordibus nostris: Eph.3.17. Fide, ceu scuto, iacula mali illius ignita exstinguimus: Eph.6.16. Per fidem Euangelij uno pariter animo decertamus: Phil.1.27. page.notes: Greek phrase after "celebratur" is uncertain and marked [?]. "uniuersorum" and "patrissamus" are read with doubt. Catchword "race" at the foot right, not repeated in the text. Page-number and running head as printed.
